episodes.188166: Heavy rain brought flooding to the Black River, Cache River, and White River during the middle of January.
episodes.193466: Minor river flooding occurred along the Arkansas River in Florence, CO due to an ice jam downstream.

events.narrative: Heavy rain brought flooding to the White River at Augusta January 16-20, 2024.

Received call from Mykel Kroll, Fremont County Emergency Manager, notifying us of some minor flooding occurring along the Arkansas River in Florence from an ice jam downstream. Inundation of low-lying areas mostly occurred between the river and County Rd 119 in the town of Florence. No other impacts reported.
